script_text: September cracks your identity wide open. Pluto transits your 1st House in Aquarius, this air sign's core identity under seismic reconstruction. Uranus, your ruling planet, is supercharging every shift this month. Drop every mask. Venus in Leo ignites your 7th House of partnership, bringing passionate romantic energy into your closest bond. Expect bold, transformative conversations that reshape how you love this month. Saturn pressures your 2nd House of finances, forcing hard truths about money and self-worth. Practical restructuring builds long-term security, even if it stings. Mars in Aries fires your 3rd House, supercharging drive but risking burnout. Mark September 15th when Mercury conjoins Pluto in your 8th House, exposing a hidden breakthrough. September 28th squares your financial and relational axes, forcing a major decision. Don't let Pluto's intensity drive irreversible decisions from temporary emotion. This month rewrites you — share with the Aquarius who needs it.
